name: Nordlys Spaces
description: Arc-style spaces for Spotify. Each space keeps its own playlists, albums and artists, colors, last page and what it was playing. Works with any theme.

name: Nordlys Codex
description: A terminal with a classical streak: monospace type, hairlines instead of panels, a big italic serif for titles and grayscale artwork. Bone, Frost and Lichen palettes.

name: Nordlys Spaces theme
description: Spotify as a browser-style workspace: a grainy gradient window with the main view floating on it as a card. Follows your space's colors when the Spaces extension is installed.
